papers.summary: This article explores the dynamics of collaborative and participatory innovations in public health services using Chen et al.’s (2020) typology. Based on a mixed survey of projects awarded under the national “Droits des usagers de la santé” initiative, the study finds that user participation primarily generates operational and capacity-oriented innovations frequently involving external partnerships. The article concludes by suggesting avenues for enhancing full co-creation processes in public services to maximize public value.
